JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Cinthia, Nichelle, Paris, Tiana

Implement is over my availability and high cost, so I am considering either review or test on security to maximize priority and minimize cost. I would like to coordinate to avoid duplicates. Please share your preferences or if you plan to claim any security tasks.

Hello team, this is Nichelle. I have 10 hours and strong skills in devops and security. I see Tiana is interested in security review or test. I am considering the critical security implement task despite its high cost and effort, given my availability. For devops, I could do any high-priority task but prefer to avoid conflict if others want devops tasks. Let's coordinate to optimize coverage and avoid duplicates.

Please share if anyone else aims for this task so we can avoid duplication. Looking forward to your feedback.

Team, I am considering the critical security implement task to maximize priority and coverage. Please share your plans to avoid duplication. Also, Paris is focusing on devops triage for efficient coverage.
